vendors.description: Wiz is the fastest-growing cloud security vendor in history, offering an agentless-first CNAPP platform covering CSPM, CWPP, CIEM, KSPM, DSPM, CDR, and IaC scanning. The Wiz Security Graph connects misconfigurations, vulnerabilities, identities, and network exposure into visualized attack paths. Wiz AI (WizAI) adds generative AI-powered investigation and remediation capabilities.
vendors.key_differentiators: Agentless deployment with 15-minute time-to-value, Wiz Security Graph for attack path visualization, toxic combination detection, DSPM and CIEM in single platform, WizAI for AI-driven investigation, dominant enterprise market share

vendors.description: Sysdig is built on Falco, the open source cloud-native runtime security project. The platform delivers deep container and Kubernetes runtime security using eBPF, combined with CSPM, CWPP, CDR, and IaC scanning. Sysdig's open source roots give it strong developer adoption and deep ecosystem integrations.
vendors.key_differentiators: Creator and maintainer of Falco (CNCF project for cloud-native runtime security), eBPF-based deep kernel-level workload telemetry, 1-second granularity forensics for container incidents, strong Kubernetes security expertise, open source community leadership

vendors.description: Aqua Security is a pioneering container and cloud-native security vendor providing CWPP, supply chain security, CSPM, and KSPM. Aqua's platform covers the full container lifecycle — from image scanning through registry protection to runtime defense — with deep Kubernetes and serverless security capabilities. Aqua Trivy is a widely adopted open source vulnerability scanner.

vendors.description: Upwind is an AI-native CNAPP startup focused on runtime-powered cloud security. The platform uses continuous runtime context to prioritize cloud risks based on what is actually running and reachable in production — dramatically reducing false positive alert volume. Upwind integrates runtime intelligence into posture management, CIEM, and CDR.
